name: AKBARAL! Design System
description: The single source of truth for the AKBARAL! visual identity across the website, the Android app and the future iOS app. Deep obsidian foundation, a single emerald atmosphere (#2f8348 — the AKBARAL! primary accent), premium glass surfaces, cinematic lighting, disciplined technical typography. Generated consumers: public/tokens.css (web), mobile/src/theme.ts (Android), design-system/ios/AKBARALTheme.swift (future iOS). Run `node design-system/build.mjs` after editing.
principles: Obsidian first — content floats on deep space, never on flat gray.
One accent: #2f8348 emerald. It marks what is interactive or live, and nothing else.
Atmosphere is emerald and restrained — glows and gradients, never floods.
Hairlines and fine grids carry the technical elegance; borders are whispers.
Glass means depth: surfaces blur what is behind them instead of painting over it.
Motion is cinematic but restrained; it always respects reduced-motion.
Honesty in visuals: every diagram represents real, implemented behavior.
One identity, native feel: same tokens everywhere, platform-native layouts.

web.sans: "Inter", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
web.mono: "Space Grotesk Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

families.mobile: Native system font (SF Pro on iOS, Roboto on Android) — same scale, weight and tracking semantics as web.

typography.notes: Web keeps its fluid clamp() display sizes (see styles.css); the token scale is the shared hierarchy reference. Eyebrows/kickers are always micro: uppercase, tracking +2, mono on web.

border.note: All structural borders are 1px hairlines in the line ramp. Accent borders use lineAccent. Never 2px+ structural borders.

glass.usage: Sticky header, auth card, modals/scrims, toasts, dropdown sheets. Mobile approximates glass with surfaceSolid + hairline + top sheen (no blur).

card.note: Cards sit on bg2 with a hairline border; premium feel comes from the sheen + shadow, not heavy fills.

motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion (web) / AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled (mobile): disable parallax, marquees, magnetic pull, particle drift and pulses; keep instant opacity-only state changes. All entrance reveals settle to visible.

status.note: Status dots: 8-10px circle with a soft glow in the status color; running/live states pulse. Same mapping and behavior on web and mobile.

sigil.formula: hue = 222 + (fnv1a(name + '|' + category) % 78) — a deterministic indigo→violet band (222..299)
sigil.monogram: Initials of the first two words of the agent name (single word: first two characters), uppercase.
sigil.container: Rounded-square (radius lg), 1px border hsla(hue,90%,74%,0.42), fill hsla(hue,90%,64%,0.15), monogram text hsla(hue,95%,82%,1), weight 800.
sigil.note: The sigil is THE agent identity mark — identical formula on web, Android and iOS. It gives 4,001 agents a calm, consistent visual language without 4,001 colors.

iconography.note: Geometric unicode glyph set shared by web and mobile for navigation and system concepts — always accompanied by a text label. Status is always a colored dot, never a glyph.

responsive.safeArea: respect safe-area-inset-top/bottom on every fixed/anchored surface (nav bars, sheets, footers, scroll content)

composition.phone: single-column, full-width primary actions <=560px, 2x2 fact grids, internal-only horizontal scroll
composition.tablet: stacked generous panels 768-1023, two-column workspaces from 1024
composition.desktop: one-row navigation, cinematic hero, controlled max-width 1200 with atmospheric sides

responsive.heroVideo: object-fit cover, container clips overscan, poster fallback, reduced-motion honors static frame
